describe.description: The creature in the image is shown in strict side profile facing right against a plain off-white background. From the head to the mid-body and wings it has the appearance of a large brown raptor, with dense layered brown feathers, folded wings, and thick feathered legs ending in large yellow scaly feet with black talons. The head is that of an eagle with a hooked beak and a golden eye. The posterior, where a feathered tail would normally be, instead bears a hanging cluster of fleshy, sucker-lined tentacle-like appendages. Circular sucker discs are also visible on the skin of the lower legs/thighs. The overall impression is a single upright standing bird-like body with a raptor front half and tentacles at the rear.

describe.description: A large standing bird with the head, feathered body, folded wings, and yellow taloned feet of a brown eagle, shown in right-facing profile. The plumage is rich brown with layered wing feathers and shaggy feathering on the neck and upper legs. From the rear underside where a tail would be, a cluster of brown octopus-like tentacles with pale round suckers hangs down and curls. Additional pale circular sucker marks are scattered over the feathered lower breast and thighs.
